call_points.text: FY27 EBITDA margin guidance maintained at 8-9% with exit run rate near double-digits
Q1 saw 5% raw material inflation, with 4.2% passed on to consumers via price hikes and grammage reduction
Rajkot facility recommencement expected to improve manufacturing efficiency through lower logistics and operating costs
Five consecutive quarters of sequential revenue growth; current run rate at ₹150+ Cr per month
FY27 capex planned at ₹40-45 Cr, primarily for maintenance and corporate office building in Rajkot.
Company expects additional insurance claim proceeds of ₹35 to ₹40 Cr by Q2FY27 following asset restatement.
Chana and potato stocks are secured until end of November, mitigating pulse price inflation risks for 6 to 8 months.
Management says it is optimistic about FY2027 but gives no revenue, margin or volume target.
Modasa and Nagpur plants ran at full capacity; Modasa and Nagpur switched to bio-coal amid a gas supply shortage.
Procurement partnership with Procol uses AI-driven sourcing to improve vendor engagement and pricing.

timeline.summary: Gopal Snacks re-commenced operations at its fire-restored Rajkot Main Plant with 1,05,233 MTPA capacity.
Q4FY26 results (standalone): revenue ₹409.63 Cr (+29.0% YoY), net profit ₹29.95 Cr (against a loss of ₹39.51 Cr a year earlier).

Gopal Snacks' Q4/FY26 investor presentation showed FY26 revenue of ₹1,508.2 Cr (+2.7%) and EBITDA of ₹101.3 Cr (margin 6.7%), with PAT of ₹73.7 Cr including a ₹39.3 Cr fire-insurance exceptional gain.
Gopal Snacks held its Q4FY26 earnings call, guiding to ₹330-350 Cr incremental revenue and 8-9% EBITDA margins in FY27.
Gopal Snacks promoters filed the annual SEBI Takeover Regulations disclosure confirming an 81.46% stake held as of March 31, 2026.
Q1FY27: Revenue ₹422 Cr (+31.1% YoY), EBITDA margin 7.4%; reaffirmed FY27 guidance of ₹1,800-1,900 Cr revenue and 8-9% EBITDA margin
